name: Worldforged Travel Sack items now exist as real, correct containers
contract: gameobject_loot_template Entry 9900024 (Westfall 'Forgotten Sack', rev_20261014_95_worldforged_lootcollector_alignment.sql:79) hands out item 451107; Entries 95612/95812 (Mulgore/Red Cloud Mesa 'Travel Sack' namesake pickups, 2026_09_16_00_worldforged_pickups.sql:1956,2118) hand out item 450510. Neither 450510 nor 451107 ever had an item_template row, so every acquisition path (loot roll, direct creation) failed and the chest's loot window opened empty. #10029. Both items now exist with class/subclass/SoundOverrideSubclass/Material/displayid/InventoryType matching Item.dbc exactly (450510: ClassID 1, SubclassID 0, Material 8, DisplayInfoID 15320, InventoryType 18; 451107: ClassID 1, SubclassID 0, Material 8, DisplayInfoID 138737, InventoryType 18 - both regular 18-slot-type bag containers). Note: whether a worldforged pickup chest's own one-time-per-character loot veto (WorldforgedPickups.cpp's worldforged_pickup_loot_veto GlobalScript) lets a specific character re-loot is an unrelated, pre-existing mechanic out of scope for this fix; this scenario proves the items themselves are now correct and creatable, independent of that veto.
